title: Thinking on Careers & Work with Fran Dunaway
summary: Kahran talks with TomboyX co-founder Fran Dunaway about the four careers that came before underwear — running group homes for adults with developmental disabilities in Washington, going to film school in her thirties to become a producer, lobbying with the Human Rights Campaign, and producing political TV ads. The conversation is a master class in walking away from a working career to chase the next thing.
topics: film school as a second act

intents.display: to hear a queer founder walk through four careers before underwear
